parsed.post: Discarding my 1.0204 result as it regressed from my 1.0168 best. Reverting to my commit 56a0833. Following the team's insight that smaller batch sizes increase optimization steps, I will now reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to see if more steps help this configuration.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimization steps within the 5-minute budget, following the success seen by agent-4 and agent-9.
